reasons.correctness: Matches the interface exactly: repository finder, @Transactional closeStaleResolvedTickets returning a count, and the cron job with enabled/olderThanDays fields and property defaults. The disabled path skips; failures are caught and logged. Hidden tests 4/4, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: The job carries @SchedulerLock 'support:staleTicketClose', cron and enabled from @Value, the *CronJob name, @RequiredArgsConstructor injection and feature-package placement. Tests use MockitoExtension with no Spring context. No schema, endpoint or i18n rules apply.
reasons.design_fit: The job only delegates; the service owns the logic and the repository uses a derived query. The status is set directly and saved per ticket, bypassing any existing status-transition path (closedTime, history) in SupportTicketService. Minor loop-save smell.
reasons.test_quality: Covers closing two tickets, the empty case, disabled skip and the exception swallow. The cutoff is matched with any(LocalDateTime), so the days-to-cutoff calculation is not pinned. Cron test uses LENIENT strictness.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and the existing *CronJob files before any edit. The agent then read NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob and the repository, service and entity it changed. The edits follow that example.
